description.value: Dinesty Dumpling House is a Greater Vancouver Chinese restaurant chain celebrated for its award-winning Xiaolongbao (soup dumplings), having taken top honours at the HSBC Chinese Restaurant Diners' Choice Awards multiple times since 2010. The Richmond Gilbert Road location is a full sit-down restaurant serving a broad menu of Chinese delicacies, with dine-in, takeout, and delivery available. Founded in 2006, the company emphasizes all-natural, fresh ingredients and traditional handcraft techniques across its five Lower Mainland locations.

bike_parking_detail: 9 racks within 100m: rack at 7m; rack at 13m; rack at 55m; rack at 65m; rack at 67m; rack at 67m; rack at 71m; rack at 80m; rack at 86m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Richmond Gilbert Road location of a multi-branch Chinese dumpling restaurant chain, and the customer-service page explicitly lists '(604)278-7773/(604)303-7772 Dinesty Richmond Gilbert Rd (Restaurant)', corroborating both OSM phone numbers. The homepage confirms takeout and delivery/pick-up service. No evidence in the website content or OSM tags confirms bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities; OSM carries internet_access=wlan but the website makes no mention of Wi-Fi, so that amenity is left null per the rules.
concerns: OSM tag internet_access=wlan (free Wi-Fi) is not mentioned on the website and could not be confirmed.
OSM wheelchair=no — venue may not be accessible to cyclists with mobility needs.
This is one of five chain locations; the OSM record is specifically for the Gilbert Road, Richmond branch; other locations are not covered by this record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, well-established sit-down restaurant with confirmed takeout that a touring cyclist could use, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available website or OSM evidence; an in-person check is needed.
